name: primitive-pythagorean-triples
description: 原始勾股数组的完全分类：设 a,b,c 为正整数，满足 a²+b²=c² 且 gcd(a,b,c)=1；证明交换 a,b 后存在正整数 m>n，gcd(m,n)=1 且 m 不等于 n mod 2，使 a=m²-n²，b=2mn，c=m²+n²；同时证明反方向所有满足条件的 m,n 都产生原始勾股数组。

orchestrator.analysis_summary: The previous monolithic purpose-analysis was rejected. This plan replaces it with a modular proof architecture: first extract parity and pairwise-coprimality facts from primitivity; second prove the elementary number-theoretic lemma that coprime factors of a square are squares; third use those lemmas to derive the Euclid parameters for an arbitrary primitive triple; fourth prove the converse construction directly; fifth combine the two directions into the complete classification statement. The parity lemma isolates the key case split: in every primitive triple exactly one leg is even, so after at most one swap the standard factorization (c-a)(c+a)=b^2 can be applied.
open_questions: The stated purpose requires existence of the parameters m,n and the converse construction, but does not explicitly require uniqueness of m,n up to swapping the legs; uniqueness can be added as a separate child if 'complete classification' is intended to include it.
